dedupe_keys.name: brazil monthly geocoded primary care clinic panel 2018 2023

description: This deposit provides data and code for a monthly geocoded panel of Brazilian primary healthcare clinics from January 2018 to December 2023. University of Alberta and Brazilian research collaborators merge CNES facility records with IBGE address coordinates and geographic boundaries. The provider reports 293,698 clinic identities and 15,455,219 observations in an unbalanced panel. Mendeley version 1 distributes a replication archive free under CC BY 4.0; internal file formats were not inspected. Geographic coverage is national, but coordinates are assigned from aggregated eight-digit postal-code locations, not independently surveyed clinic entrances. That positional uncertainty and changing facility coverage are limitations for travel-time or hazard exposure simulations. The CNES identifier supports linkage to other Brazilian health-system records. data-healthsites-io and data-openstreetmap are related location resources, without a verified identity crosswalk. No archive was downloaded, geocoding was not rerun and the large provider-reported clinic count was not independently audited.
name: Brazil monthly geocoded primary-care clinic panel, 2018–2023
